method: Original PNGs viewed through tools.view_image after deterministic resizing into labeled contact sheets. Hashes refer to original bytes, not derivatives. Native control facts were independently compared to the sealed original reports; event proof uses original action_index, and colors were recomputed from original PNG/native frames under the frozen policy.
limitations: Contact-sheet resizing was used to inspect context; original pixels, frame boxes and hashes are preserved. No pixel editing of original evidence, expectation rewriting, later repair-based credit, external task input, or SDK acquisition was performed.
independence: Only claims-one-T3.txt and its permitted T3 original/design/common evidence and policy inputs were used. No other grouping or claim judgment was inspected.
